planRows.shortDesc: Our stylish retreat rests along the Riviera Nayarit. Set amid palm trees, our hotel boasts access to an exclusive beach, three outdoor pools, and accommodations with balconies overlooking the Pacific Ocean. We have a spa, Mexican temazcal, a 24-hour fitness center, tennis and basketball courts, and access to land and water activities.
planRows.headline: A beachfront resort set on the Riviera Nayarit
planRows.locationShortDesc: Conrad Punta de Mita is located in the exclusive area of Punta de Mita, Nayarit, Mexico.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Nestled where the jungle meets the sea, Conrad Punta de Mita sits at the heart of the Riviera Nayarit — a haven of the region’s vibrant culture and heritage, offering unparalleled adventure and lush, untouched nature in a truly private, secluded, and awe-inspiring setting.
planRows.directionsTo:
From South: Take the southeast direction up to the "MEXICO 200" highway, bound for "TEPIC." Take turn-off to "La Cruz De Huanacaxtle" and after taking the federal highway "La Cruz De Huanacaxtle - Punta De Mita." Take turn towards "Camino A Higuera Blanca" and in 2 km, take turn towards "LITIBU" complex at the roundabout.

From North: Follow Puerto Vallarta - Tepic / México 200 and turn right onto Av. Revolucion and continue to Punta de Mita until Litibu.

From East: Follow Carr. a las Palmas / JAL 544 to A Compostela Nayarit / Blvrd. Francisco Medina Ascencio / Puerto Vallarta – Tepic / Mexico 200 in Las Juntas. Keep on Puerto Vallarta Tepic / Mexico 200 to Nayarit.

planRows.shortDesc: Among the mangroves of the magical Riviera Maya, ancient roots and a future-focused commitment to sustainability blend in a mesmerizing dance. Seek serenity in our spa, and uncover your sense of wonder in Tulum’s masterpieces - from the architectural savvy in nearby ruins, to the cool clarity in underground cenotes.
planRows.headline: A sanctuary of wonder on the coast of Riviera Maya
planRows.locationShortDesc: Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya: A serene oceanfront sanctuary with luxury rooms, gourmet dining & a world-class spa.
planRows.directionsTo:
Tulum International Airport, TQO, is about 60 minutes from the resort (38.7 m).
Cancun International Airport, CUN, is about 90 minutes from the resort (62.1 m).
Please contact the resort concierge to help arrange private transportation. Our partners in destination marketing services will help you coordinate the arrivals and departures of your group.
